facts.label: Questions on the exam
facts.note: The guide says 50 questions affect the score and 15 unscored questions are not identified. The AWS page says 65 questions.

facts.label: Question types
facts.note: Multiple choice has one correct response and three distractors. Multiple response has two or more correct responses out of five or more options.

facts.label: Time limit
facts.note: Stated on the AWS certification page.

facts.label: Minimum passing score
facts.note: Reported as a scaled score of 100 to 1,000.

value.text: Compensatory: you need to pass only the overall exam, not each section. Unanswered questions are scored as incorrect and there is no penalty for guessing.
